title: Community schematic submissions launched
summary: Players can now submit schematics, help others find requested builds and earn recognition for contributing.
description: A new community schematic system was introduced after a poll, alongside opt-in roles for polls and updates.

body.text: Members can upload schematics for recent farms to help other players and may receive a reward for useful contributions.
Players can request wanted schematics using the dedicated request format.
Members can choose poll and update roles through the Server Guide.
